title: Beatrix and the Glasshouse
author: Marguerite Coldharbour
blurb: Yara Voss, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
